About

I'm a technology generalist with a scientist's curiosity. Started with C/C++ and Python, then expanded into web, AI, and data. I keep my toolkit broad and practical — as Heinlein put it, "Specialization is for insects."

I believe in simple systems that scale, code that reads like prose, and teams that own their work end-to-end. I prioritize shipping over perfection, but never compromise on reliability. My approach: reduce complexity, automate what compounds, measure what matters.

Away from the keyboard, I'm with my family — exploring new places, nature, and making music.

I am the founder of Persevie , and I am creating something special for the world.

Projects

Over the years, I've worked on some exciting projects. I've always strived to push the boundaries of innovation. Each project is a new adventure, and I relish the challenges they bring.

  • Grimoire CSS

    A Rust-powered CSS engine built for flexibility, reusable dynamic styling, and ruthless performance across environments.

  • Statemanjs

    A framework-agnostic state library for JavaScript and Node.js with predictable flows, minimal boilerplate, and solid DX.

  • EBEXJS

    A tiny, high-performance event bus for local app communication, event management, and decoupled components.

Experience

Over the years, I've had the chance to try many different roles in the tech industry. From planning product roadmaps and writing code to mentoring new developers, each experience has been part of my journey of growth and learning. I've worked with talented people across various countries and companies, always aiming to create innovative solutions and supportive team environments. My journey has helped me shape the technical direction of projects, lead creative efforts, and tackle new challenges in the ever-changing tech world.

I lead engineering and product execution end-to-end: set technical strategy and architecture, align with product, turn goals into roadmaps, and deliver reliable systems at scale. I design teams and processes that keep delivery predictable.

My operating model prioritizes reliability, performance, security, and cost. I reduce complexity, automate where it compounds, and manage by metrics — SLAs/SLOs, quality, cycle time, and throughput. Standards, CI/CD, and clear ownership are non-negotiable.
